description: Source code for handling ARJ archive operations including listing, testing, extracting, adding, and deleting files, with functions for parsing output and managing archive properties.

methods.name: xa_arj_ask
methods.description: Configures archive capabilities based on archive type and read-only status.

methods.name: xa_arj_password_str
methods.description: Generates password string for archive operations, escaping bad characters.

methods.name: xa_arj_parse_output
methods.description: Parses output lines from ARJ archive listing to extract file information.

methods.name: xa_arj_list
methods.description: Lists contents of an ARJ archive.

methods.name: xa_arj_test
methods.description: Tests the integrity of an ARJ archive.

methods.name: xa_arj_extract
methods.description: Extracts specified files from an ARJ archive.

methods.name: xa_arj_add
methods.description: Adds files to an ARJ archive.

methods.name: xa_arj_delete
methods.description: Deletes files from an ARJ archive.
